statement: A deposit leg hard-reverts on failure and travels alone in its batch. The Quint cell holds the hard revert and the sign-only-after-simulation rule with planted bugs; that a deposit leg travels alone in its batch is pinned by a scenario test (depositFundsThePaymentBehindItTest) with no planted bug.
